executiveSummary: Southwest Europe faces a severe wildfire emergency, with more than 300,000 people evacuated across France and Spain amid major road closures and at least one fatality reported in Spain. View Article In Washington State, USA, wildfires triggered evacuations for about 60,000-67,000 people, destroyed an estimated 600-850 structures, and forced patient transfers from a veterans medical facility. Source Update Greece's Attica region, including Megara and areas west of Athens, continues to see multi-front wildfires with fresh evacuations and at least two firefighter fatalities; dozens of homes have been destroyed and sea evacuations occurred as access routes were cut. View Article Europe's heatwave placed all major Italian cities on red alert, strained transport and energy networks, and contributed to wildfire and drought risks; a grass fire temporarily closed Heathrow's southern runway in the UK. View Article Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, reports at least 36-38 deaths, over 100 injuries, and 8,500+ people sheltering in extreme heat after a destructive earthquake; around 46,000 households lacked water and thousands of buildings sustained damage. Reporting varies across updates. Source Guatemala's Fuego volcano affected roughly 29,000 people with ashfall and kept about 1,700 in shelters; authorities warned the next 72 hours were critical due to lahar risk during rains. View Article Typhoon Dolphin prompted school and port closures across parts of Zhejiang, Fujian, and Shanghai as authorities warned of severe flood and landslide risks. View Article In Okinawa, hundreds sheltered as a typhoon crossed the islands; Naha Airport closed with all flights canceled and at least three elderly residents injured. Source Mid-July US floods caused deaths, hundreds of rescues, and infrastructure damage across Texas, Missouri, and parts of the Northeast, including bridge failure and submerged interstates. Texas Northeast/Updates Serbia declared large-scale wildfire responses under extreme heat and drought, including army support to protect threatened communities. View Article
